rationale: A generic render-backend change. The surface's idle GPU trim ages a resource by frames as well as wall time, so a resource is freed only after both 2 s and 30 frames without use; it still frees only resources nothing references, so presented pixels are unchanged. Pulp continues to own these targets under the 2026-10-04 design-import refactor inheritance decision; Vellum inherits the change when the targets adopt the Vellum package. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'GpuIdleTrimSchedule ages by frames as well as time'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SkiaSurface idle trim keeps what a recent frame released across a pause'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SkiaSurface idle trim runs once per second of frames'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SkiaSurface idle trim frees textures unused for two seconds and keeps the drawn one'
